data.title: 白井黑子 · 宿舍长发散落的卸防瞬间
data.description: 常盘台宿舍深夜静谧的台灯下，黑子卸下了风纪委员的红袖标。她轻轻解开两侧的双马尾发带，柔顺的茶红色卷发彻底披散在单薄的白衬衫肩头。解开第一颗扣子后，她坐在床沿微微仰头，茶色眼眸中退去了白日的凌厉与吵闹，只余下温润如水的深情凝望。
data.action: taking off twin tail ribbons, hair cascading down, sitting on bed edge
data.lighting: warm golden desk lamp casting soft shadows
data.promptProse: Seated on the edge of her dorm bed at night, Shirai Kuroko removes her twin hair ribbons, letting her tea-red curly hair cascade freely down her shoulders. Her school blouse is gently unbuttoned at the neck as she gazes softly with tender, unguarded affection.
data.animaCaption: Kuroko letting her long hair down gently in her quiet dorm room.
